task.title: P6-156: Fix ContextMenuItem focus restore in both directions
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Accessibility). Original id: P6-156. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-components.md.

**`ContextMenuItem`'s focus handling is wrong in two directions** (was `P6-024c` + `P6-024d`). It suppresses the focus restore for *every* item (`context_menu.rs:483`), but only the move dialog focuses anything — so activating `New binder inside…`/`Rename…`/`Delete…` from the new keyboard route leaves focus on `<body>` and those dialogs must be Tab-reached from the document start. And `restore_focus` is reset only inside the effect's `else if is_open` branch (`:289`), so any close path where the popover was never actually shown leaves it stuck `false`, silently disabling focus restore for the *next* dismissal.
